"""Plain-text rendering of an invoice."""
from invoicing.models import Invoice
from invoicing.pricing import line_total, total


def render_text(invoice: Invoice) -> str:
    out = [
        f"Invoice {invoice.number}",
        f"Customer: {invoice.customer}",
        f"Issued: {invoice.issued.isoformat()}",
        "",
    ]
    for line in invoice.lines:
        out.append(f"{line.quantity:>3} x {line.description:<20} {line_total(line):>10}")
    out.append("")
    out.append(f"{'Total':<26} {total(invoice):>10}")
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"

def _tail(text, n):
    return text.splitlines()[-n:]


def test_subtotal_only_when_no_discount_and_no_tax():
    text = render_text(invoice(line(2, "9.99")))
    assert _tail(text, 2) == [
        "Subtotal                        19.98",
        "Total                           19.98",
    ]
    assert "Discount" not in text
    assert "Tax" not in text


def test_discount_line_is_negative():
    text = render_text(invoice(line(1, "100.00"), discount_code="WELCOME10"))
    assert _tail(text, 3) == [
        "Subtotal                       100.00",
        "Discount (WELCOME10)           -10.00",
        "Total                           90.00",
    ]


def test_tax_line_when_tax_nonzero():
    text = render_text(invoice(line(1, "100.00"), region="UK"))
    assert _tail(text, 3) == [
        "Subtotal                       100.00",
        "Tax                             20.00",
        "Total                          120.00",
    ]


def test_discount_and_tax_in_order():
    text = render_text(invoice(line(1, "100.00"), region="UK", discount_code="PARTNER25"))
    assert _tail(text, 4) == [
        "Subtotal                       100.00",
        "Discount (PARTNER25)           -25.00",
        "Tax                             15.00",
        "Total                           90.00",
